title: microsoft/agent-framework
raw_summary: A framework for building, orchestrating and deploying multi-agent systems with tool calling, typed memory and human-in-the-loop approvals. Ships a graph runtime, a tool registry with JSON Schema validation and an evaluation harness.

title: example/arm-infer
raw_summary: A C++20 inference engine targeting 2x throughput on ARM. INT4 kernels plus a work-stealing scheduler; reports 2.1x tokens/s over llama.cpp on Raspberry Pi 5 and Apple M4 with a reproducible benchmark harness.

title: ggml-org/llama.cpp
raw_summary: LLM inference in C/C++. Daily commits: minor CUDA kernel tuning, a fix for the Metal backend on macOS 15.4, and documentation updates for the new quantization types.

title: Show HN: I built a local-first memory store for LLM agents
raw_summary: SQLite plus embeddings, but facts are stored as editable rows instead of raw transcripts. Includes a diff view so you can see exactly what the agent remembered and delete a single fact without wiping the whole session.

title: Show HN: A local-first memory store for LLM agents (SQLite + embeddings)
raw_summary: Same project reposted: SQLite plus embeddings, facts stored as editable rows instead of raw transcripts, with a diff view for auditing what the agent remembered.

title: Anthropic publishes a practical guide to building effective agents
raw_summary: A guide to agent patterns: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer, with explicit when-not-to-use guidance. The most useful part is the section on why most workflows should not be agents.

title: Anthropic raises $4B at a $183B valuation
raw_summary: The round was led by existing investors. The company says the capital goes to compute and safety research. No product changes were announced.

title: OpenWrt 25.12 released with nftables by default and faster WireGuard
raw_summary: Release notes: nftables is now the default firewall backend, WireGuard throughput on mt7621 improved by roughly 40%, LuCI dashboard rewritten, and a smaller image profile for 8MB devices. Upgrade notes warn about firewall config migration.

title: OpenWrt 25.12 upgrade notes: what breaks when nftables becomes the default
raw_summary: A walkthrough of the firewall migration: legacy iptables rules are not converted automatically, and the image profile changes break some 8MB devices. Includes a rollback procedure and a list of packages that still depend on iptables.

title: Why most proactive AI assistants eventually become notification spam, and what the three common failure modes are when you mix content recommendations into transactional alerts without a feedback loop or quiet hours
raw_summary: 从通知疲劳的角度分析主动式 Agent：缺少反馈回路、没有静默时段、把内容推荐混进事务提醒，是三个常见失败模式。文末给出了一个基于已读率动态调频的简单方案。
